purpose: Measured garment-only preview profiles: keeper plus sixteen distinct families. No cuff masks; no release or full anatomy acceptance implied.
colourConvention: inkRGB/groundRGB are hexadecimal display colours; ink/ground are equivalent 0..255 RGB arrays consumed by the parent texture helper.
applicationRules: Require sourceSHA256 equality before applying a profile. A changed candidate requires remeasurement or explicit geometry-equivalence proof.

Each proposed spatial/colour selector needs parent rendered front/back and fold inspection, UV overlap exclusion and the existing non-texture byte/rig/animation preservation checks. Selected vertex samples prove a real surface basis, not every rasterised texel.
Use the role wardrobe image only as measurement aid. PNG camera pose is not the rest coordinate frame and may predate current rig weights.
Do not decorate skin, palms, fingers, hair, feet or props. No keeper or generic cuff masks. Keep patterns out of unresolved costume fixes.
Monks T only at low strength. Do not increase ornament or contrast to simulate a religious costume.
Do not apply one role hem height to another role. These are independently inspected bounded preview bands; asymmetric sash/robe edges may require a parent chart/edge-aware mask after preview.
